description.narrative: Att stärka SRK som strategisk civilsamhällesaktör och få genomslag för svenska prioriteringar på den internationella humanitära arenan.

To strengthen Swedish Red Cross (SRD) as a strategic NGO and implement Swedish priorities on the international humanitarian arena. Regarding gender equality, coded as a significant objective for the contribution, gender analysis is part of the SRC’s sustainability platform. Through the sustainability platform, SRC implements targeted efforts to address gender equality, empowerment of women, girls, people with disabilities and marginalized groups. SRK supports female leadership through its ”GLOW Red”-initiative, which promotes female leaders through mentorship programs, knowledge and information exchanges, and technical support. Other perspectives advocated through the sustainability platform are support of democracy and peace and security.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution
